name: Void Gun Overhaul
description:
A complete progression overhaul for Sandustry's Void Gun.

Features:
- Five Terrain Ability tiers: convert Dune to Sand, remove Stone, mine Copper, melt Ice into Water, and remove Sandstone.
- Five Blast Radius tiers, adding 4 cells of radius per level.
- Two additional native Tank Capacity tiers, raising maximum Voidjuice storage to 14,000.
- Sunsand caught in the blast becomes stable Sand.
- Preserves the normal Voidjuice cost, charging, visuals, sounds, and native resource drops.
author: Cooper
